finding: the person-shaped-fixture check reds on one already-adjudicated lesson title that VB evidence quotes
status: NOT ACTIONED — needs Matt's decision, and the edit was declined here
whenItSurfaced: Only now. This step sits after the qa-record control in the same CI job, so on every earlier run of this branch it never executed: the control failed first and the job stopped. Fixing the control did not create this; it revealed it.

measurement.redControlDetail: the seeded person-shaped fixture reds the real tree — 108 hits while seeded, 107 with the seed removed

noPupilNameIsInvolved: The token names no person. It is a real LAUNCH ASDAN W11 careers lesson and it trips the predicate only because MOCK is a fixture marker and the surrounding words are ordinary titlecase, so Mock/Interview/Answer/Evidence/Improve reads as person-shaped. That exact string is ALREADY in the tool's own allowlist for three LAUNCH_ASDAN paths and for the checker itself, ruled by Order N6 on 2026-08-28: 'real careers lesson title; MOCK is a fixture marker but this names no person.' Across the whole 3,524-file tree the only other person-shaped strings are the checker's declared red vectors and the ledger's dated record of the canary, each allowlisted with its reason. S23_NAMES does not exist in the repository.
whyVBEvidenceQuotesIt: g11 and g18 measure a candidate against its family's whole corpus, and that lesson is a member of the LAUNCH ASDAN corpus, so its filename appears in the corpus listings the evidence records. Renaming it in the evidence would falsify the evidence; the lesson itself is live and is not VB's to rename.
theFix: Ten entries in the tool's ALLOW list, one per file, same token and same reason as the three that are already there. The allowlist is keyed on (file, text) by the tool's own design — its comment says an allowlist that covers a whole file is 'an excuse with a filename' — so ten per-file entries keep every OTHER person-shaped string in those same files catchable.
whyNotDone: This is the estate's pupil-name safeguarding control. Widening its allowlist is a safeguarding decision, not a build fix, and it is Matt's to make even though the token is already adjudicated and no name is involved. The edit was also declined at the tool level here, which is the right default for this file. Not retried, not worked around.
doNotFixByOtherMeans: Never by renaming the lesson in the evidence, never by exempting a directory, never by deleting the evidence that names it, and never by relaxing the predicate.
